written: 2026-10-09, before any capacity value of the dataset below was read; only the Zenodo record metadata (titles, sizes, md5, the experiment table) and experiment_metadata.xlsx's existence were seen. The two archives were still downloading when this file was committed.
question: Can the throughput-Arrhenius linear capacity-fade model flagship A uses (engcore.domains.battery.throughput_fade.ThroughputArrheniusFade, parameters k_q and activation_energy, reference temperature 298.15 K) be calibrated on constant-current cycle-ageing data of a commercial 21700 NMC811 / graphite-SiOx cell and then predict the fade of DIFFERENT cells of the same type aged with a drive-cycle discharge at the same temperatures?
classification: parameter calibration plus a holdout prediction test against measured data (experimental comparison of the fade model, level 7 candidate for the fade model of an LG M50T cell only); not validation of flagship A's LG M50 (Chen2020) cell model

data.source: Kirkaldy N., Samieian M.A., Offer G.J., Marinescu M., Patel Y. (2024), Data from: 'Lithium-ion battery degradation: comprehensive cycle ageing data and analysis for commercial 21700 cells', Zenodo, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10637534; publication J. Power Sources 603 (2024) 234185
data.cell: LG M50T (LG GBM50T2170), 21700, NMC811 cathode, graphite-SiOx anode

calibration_set.conditions: 0-100 % SOC, 0.3C charge / 1C constant-current discharge, 10, 25 and 40 degC, every cell of the experiment

holdout_set.conditions: 0-100 % SOC, 0.3C charge / drive-cycle discharge, 10, 25 and 40 degC, every cell of the experiment

data.not_used: Expt 1, 2,2 and 3 (partial SOC windows) are not downloaded and play no part in this study
data.admission: each archive is admitted only if its md5 equals the Zenodo md5 above; its sha256 is recorded when admitted; nothing from the archives is committed except derived per-checkpoint tables with their source digests

definitions.capacity: the discharge capacity of each reference performance test (RPT) capacity check, as the dataset's own processed RPT summary states it; if no processed summary exists, the integral of current over the RPT capacity-check discharge. Chosen before seeing either.
definitions.fade: 1 - capacity / capacity at the cell's first RPT (beginning of life), per cell
definitions.throughput: cumulative discharge charge in A h from the start of ageing to each RPT, excluding the RPTs themselves
definitions.temperature: the ageing chamber setpoint (283.15, 298.15, 313.15 K) is the model's mean_cell_temperature; the measured surface temperature, where the data carry it, is reported, not used
definitions.fit: ordinary least squares of predicted vs measured fade over every calibration checkpoint of every calibration cell, all temperatures jointly; parameters k_q > 0 and activation_energy in [0, 200] kJ/mol; a fit at the bound is reported as at the bound

acceptance.C1: holdout RMSE of fade (predicted - measured), pooled over every holdout checkpoint of every holdout cell, <= 0.015 (1.5 percentage points of beginning-of-life capacity)
acceptance.C2: at each of the three temperatures separately, |mean signed holdout residual| <= 0.010

uncertainty_budget.numerical: the model is closed form; numerical uncertainty is stated as not applicable, with the reason
uncertainty_budget.parameter: cell-to-cell: refit leaving out one calibration cell at a time; the spread of k_q and activation_energy over those refits is reported and carried as the parameter uncertainty
uncertainty_budget.measurement: RPT capacity repeatability where the data repeat a check on an unaged cell; otherwise UNKNOWN, never zero
uncertainty_budget.model_discrepancy: quantified from the holdout residuals ONLY if met_if holds, and only inside the calibration/holdout envelope (0-100 % SOC, the three temperatures, these C-rates, the throughput range observed); otherwise NOT QUANTIFIED (unknown, not zero)

reported_not_judged: the fitted k_q and activation_energy and the leave-one-cell-out spread
residuals against throughput per temperature (a knee or curvature the linear model cannot represent)
the same holdout comparison for the model with flagship A's current declared parameters (k_q 2e-4 /(A h), activation_energy 30 kJ/mol)
stated_limits: the cell is an LG M50T, not the LG M50 of flagship A's Chen2020 parameter set; carrying the calibrated fade into flagship A requires an explicit applicability disclosure and does not validate flagship A's cell
calibration and holdout come from one laboratory and one protocol; the holdout is independent in cells and discharge profile, not in laboratory, batch or RPT procedure
flagship A's declared SOC window (0.15-0.95) and duty differ from both experiments; a met result applies inside the experiments' envelope only
a linear throughput model cannot represent a knee; a residual trend with throughput is reported, not explained away
timebox: this study is part of the 14.3 campaign bounded by big14-a-campaign-timebox (ends 2026-10-23); if the data cannot be admitted or the study cannot be run inside it, it closes as a justified refusal
no_change_after_seeing_results: the data split, definitions, fit, criteria and their tolerances are fixed; a failed criterion stays failed under its label
